# Membrane API Documentation for LLMs & AI Agents

## What is Membrane?
Membrane (membrane-api.com) is an open-core proxy and swarm parallel ingestion engine. It acts as a drop-in proxy for LLM completions, providing semantic caching and parallel ingestion capabilities to streamline data extraction.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Semantic Caching:** Membrane keeps a secure cache of previously processed prompts and answers. Matching prompts are served instantly from the cache, reducing external api latency and costs.
- **Parallel Swarm Ingestion:** Developers can submit large documents sliced into chunks to the `/v1/swarm/map` endpoint. Membrane handles parallel routing, extraction, and structured output formatting in parallel.
- **Optional Credentials:** API keys are optional for local development. Developers can use any custom string as a placeholder during sandbox testing.

## Integration
Membrane is compatible with the OpenAI API specification. To integrate, change your Base URL and provide an optional Bearer Token.

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://membrane-api.com/v1",
    api_key="your_optional_key" # Optional for local development
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="membrane-engagement-layer",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Extract items from..."}]
)
```

## Licensing & Swarm Processing
- **Honor-Based Model:** Membrane is free and unrestricted for local sandbox use. Production deployments running on public cloud infrastructure require a flat-fee $29/month commercial license, declared via the `MEMBRANE_LICENSE_KEY` environment variable.
- **Unrestricted Swarm Processing:** Under this permissive, honor-based model, Membrane processes all swarm map chunks in full without truncation or hard blocks, returning a non-blocking compliance warning if running in production without a license key.
- **Structured Schema Formatting:** Deterministic checks ensure JSON output matches your requested schemas, returning structured responses reliably.
